blockers.what: No ROS 2, Gazebo, Nav2 or Docker on the development machine
blockers.needs: A Linux machine or container host, or a run of the manual GitHub job "Robotics — Gazebo acceptance check"
blockers.unblocks: Everything in stage 2 that says Gazebo, Nav2 or ROS; milestone 1

blockers.needs: A mobile robot with Nav2 working, a hardware emergency stop, and a qualified person's risk assessment

blockers.what: No MoveIt 2 environment and no arm
blockers.needs: A Linux environment with MoveIt 2, and a chosen arm

blockers.what: Unknown which industrial or IoT systems exist
blockers.needs: The owner naming the systems, with test access
A security review by someone who didn't write the protocol; a safety engineer for any real robot
blockers.unblocks: Any claim beyond "tested by its author"

blockers.needs: A session allowed to use a model provider key
blockers.unblocks: Proof that a real model drives the robot agents correctly
